from statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters import ExponentialSmoothing
def forecast_ets(train, h=3, seasonal='mul', trend='mul', damped=False):
    fit=ExponentialSmoothing(train, trend=trend, damped_trend=damped, seasonal=seasonal, seasonal_periods=12, initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
    return fit.forecast(h).iloc[-1]
def forecast_reg(train_df, target_date, use_promo=False):
    tt=np.arange(len(train_df))
    tmp=train_df.copy().reset_index()
    tmp['t_abs'] = ((tmp['date'].dt.year-2022)*12 + tmp['date'].dt.month) # absolute
    tmp['month']=tmp.period_month
    if use_promo:
        tmp=tmp.dropna(subset=['promo_intensity'])
        X=tmp[['t_abs','month','promo_intensity']]
        pre=ColumnTransformer([('month',OneHotEncoder(drop='first', handle_unknown='ignore'),['month']),('num',StandardScaler(),['t_abs','promo_intensity'])])
        pipe=make_pipeline(pre,Ridge(alpha=1))
        pipe.fit(X,tmp.sales_units)
        promo=tmp[tmp.month==target_date.month]['promo_intensity'].mean()
        if np.isnan(promo): promo=tmp.promo_intensity.mean()
        return pipe.predict(pd.DataFrame({'t_abs':[(target_date.year-2022)*12+target_date.month],'month':[target_date.month],'promo_intensity':[promo]}))[0]
    else:
        X=tmp[['t_abs','month']]
        pre=ColumnTransformer([('month',OneHotEncoder(drop='first', handle_unknown='ignore'),['month']),('num',StandardScaler(),['t_abs'])])
        pipe=make_pipeline(pre,Ridge(alpha=1))
        pipe.fit(X,tmp.sales_units)
        return pipe.predict(pd.DataFrame({'t_abs':[(target_date.year-2022)*12+target_date.month],'month':[target_date.month]}))[0]
def seasonal_naive(train, h=3):
    return train.iloc[-12+h-1] if len(train)>=12 else train.iloc[-1]
# eval cutoffs from 2024-12 to 2025-09
results=[]
for cutoff in pd.date_range('2024-12-01','2025-09-01',freq='MS'):
    train_y=y[:cutoff]
    target=cutoff+pd.DateOffset(months=3)
    actual=y[target]
    train_df=df[:cutoff]
    preds={}
    preds['snaive']=seasonal_naive(train_y,3)
    preds['ets_mulmul']=forecast_ets(train_y,3,'mul','mul',False)
    preds['ets_addnone']=forecast_ets(train_y,3,'add',None,False)
    preds['ets_addadd']=forecast_ets(train_y,3,'add','add',False)
    preds['reg_trend_month']=forecast_reg(train_df,target,False)
    preds['reg_promo_month']=forecast_reg(train_df,target,True)
    # YoY avg growth: target same month last year * recent total ratio last 12 vs prev 12 at cutoff? 
    last_year = y[target-pd.DateOffset(years=1)]
    ratio = train_y.iloc[-12:].sum()/train_y.iloc[-24:-12].sum() if len(train_y)>=24 else 1
    preds['yoy_recent_growth']=last_year*ratio
    for k,p in preds.items():
        results.append({'cutoff':cutoff,'target':target,'model':k,'pred':p,'actual':actual,'ape':abs(p-actual)/actual})
res=pd.DataFrame(results)
res.groupby('model').agg(mape=('ape','mean'), median=('ape','median'), wmape=('pred', lambda s: np.nan))

# wmape
grp=[]
for m,g in res.groupby('model'):
    grp.append((m, np.sum(abs(g.pred-g.actual))/np.sum(g.actual), g.ape.mean(), g.ape.median()))
pd.DataFrame(grp, columns=['model','wmape','mape','median']).sort_values('wmape')

# create ensemble cv equal of selected models: ets_addnone, reg_promo, yoy_recent_growth, ets_mulmul, snaive? maybe
sel=['ets_addnone','reg_promo_month','yoy_recent_growth','ets_mulmul','snaive']
ens=res[res.model.isin(sel)].pivot_table(index=['cutoff','target','actual'], columns='model', values='pred').reset_index()
ens['pred_mean']=ens[sel].mean(axis=1)
ens['ape']=abs(ens.pred_mean-ens.actual)/ens.actual
ens['pe']=(ens.pred_mean-ens.actual)/ens.actual
ens[['target','actual','pred_mean','ape','pe']]
